identificationModule.briefTitle: Pd1 Antibody Sintilimab ± Chemoradiotherapy for Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Pd1 Antibody Sintilimab ± Chemoradiotherapy for Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: In this study, participants with locally advanced rectal cancer patients will be treated according to MMR/MSI status. There will be two cohorts in this study: Cohort A and Cohort B. For Cohort A, dMMR or MSI-H patients will receive 4 cycles of neoadjuvant Pd1 antibody Sintilimab,followed by one of the following treatments: (1) surgery and adjuvant treatment, (2）another 4 cycles of sintilimab, followed by radical surgery or observation (only for cCR) . For Cohort B, pMMR/MSS/MSI-L patients will be randomized to receive neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy ± four cycles of Pd1 antibody Sintilimab，followed by one of the following treatments: (1) curative surgery and four cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy;(2)four cycles of chemotherapy then observation (only cCR after neoadjuvant therapy)

armGroups.label: Cohort A
armGroups.description: After 4 cycles of neoadjuvant sintilimab treatment, the patients and doctors could choose one of the following treatments: (1) surgery, followed by 4 cycles of adjuvant sintilimab with or without Capeox chemotherapy; (2) another 4 cycles of sintilimab, followed by radical surgery or observation (only for patients with clinical complete response).

armGroups.label: Cohort B-arm 1
armGroups.description: After four cycles of neoadjuvant Sintilimab, Capeox and radiotherapy, the patients and doctors could choose one of the following treatments: (1) curative surgery and four cycles of adjuvant Capeox chemotherapy;(2)four cycles of Capeox chemotherapy then observation (only for patients with clinical complete response after neoadjuvant therapy)

armGroups.label: Cohort B-arm 2
armGroups.description: After four cycles of neoadjuvant Capeox chemotherapy and radiotherapy, the patients and doctors could choose one of the following treatments: (1) curative surgery and four cycles of adjuvant Capeox chemotherapy;(2)four cycles of Capeox chemotherapy then observation (only for patients with clinical complete response after neoadjuvant therapy)

interventions.name: Oxaliplatin
interventions.description: 130mg/m2, d1 q3w, in Capeox regimen (100mg/m2 when used cocurrently with radiotherapy), intravenous infusion

interventions.name: Capecitabine
interventions.description: 1000mg/m2, bid, qd1-14, q3w, in Capeox regimen, oral administration

interventions.name: radiotherapy
interventions.description: neoadjuvant radiotherapy with 50Gy to GTV, 45Gy to CTV in 25 fractions.

interventions.name: total mesorectal excision
interventions.description: total mesorectal excision after neoadjuvant treatment

interventions.name: Watch and wait
interventions.description: Watch and wait for cCR patients after neoadjuvant treatment

primaryOutcomes.description: the proportion of CR cases (pCR for those who underwent surgery and cCR for those who didn't receive surgery)
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 6 weeks after curative surgery for pCR; 6 weeks after the completion of neoadjuvant therapy for cCR

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From start of treatment to 3 months after the adjuvant therapy or last dose of treatment

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Tumor regresssion grade according to AJCC TRG grading system
secondaryOutcomes.description: Tumor regresssion grade according to AJCC TRG grading system
tumor volume reduction rate (TVRR) reaching 20% or above
